description: Defines an immutable data class 'IndividualClientData' for clients with loans and savings due, including methods for creation, modification, and equality checks.

classes.name: IndividualClientData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a client with associated loans and savings data, with methods for instantiation, access, and modification.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new IndividualClientData instance with specified clientId and clientName, initializing loans and savings to null.

methods.name: withSavings
methods.description: Returns a new IndividualClientData instance with updated savings collection.

methods.name: withLoans
methods.description: Returns a new IndividualClientData instance with updated loans collection.

methods.name: getLoans
methods.description: Returns the collection of loans due.

methods.name: setLoans
methods.description: Sets the collection of loans due.

methods.name: addLoans
methods.description: Adds a LoanDueData object to the loans collection if it is not null.

methods.name: getSavings
methods.description: Returns the collection of savings due.

methods.name: setSavings
methods.description: Sets the collection of savings due.

methods.name: addSavings
methods.description: Adds a SavingsDueData object to the savings collection if it is not null.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on clientId.
